description: GET /v1/merchants/me/balance/topups - top-ups of the Live prepaid balance, newest first: amount, status (pending, credited, expired, manual_review), paymentState of the funding payment (unpaid, received, or held when it was received but not settled automatically) and its paymentUrl. Test has no balance and returns an empty list. Requires mode unless exactly one key mode is cached. Uses the cached sk_* key of that mode, else a fresh JWT. Read-only.
name: paymaster_balance_topups_list
title: List balance top-ups
